scaleNote: Same ground scale as assets/rossvalley.jpg (1640 px across 0.1025 degrees of longitude, about 5.5 m per pixel here). Equal to OpenStreetMap zoom 15 shrunk to 68.7%.
zoomNote: Equivalent zoom. The picture was drawn from OpenStreetMap vector data, not stitched from tiles: see HANDOFF.md.
tileSource: none. tile.openstreetmap.org answered every request with its Access blocked tile (HTTP body: 403, tile usage policy), so no tiles were used.
dataSource: OpenStreetMap data through the Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter), three queries for the bounds below, OSM base timestamp 2026-11-23T04:15Z
credit: Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors. City limit from OpenStreetMap, simplified.
projection: Web Mercator cropped to exact bounds: x is linear in longitude, y is linear in ln(tan(pi/4 + lat/2)). lib/geo.js toXY works unchanged with these numbers.
style: Palette measured from assets/rossvalley.jpg: paper ground #f9f9f7, built-up #efefec, buildings #d6d5d1, white streets, cream main roads, mauve freeway, grey-green parks and woods, water #cfd9db, grey labels.
